payload.core_mechanism_summary: Bitset DP: dp[i] stores achievable inner sums for total sum i. For each coin x, update using shift and OR: ndp[i] |= dp[i-x] | (dp[i-x] << x).
payload.rationale: The DP state tracks two dimensions: total sum i (0..k) and achievable inner sums (encoded in bitset). This is a classic 2D knapsack variant, perfectly matching dp_2d_state.
